commands: RUN_ID="local-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)-1"; echo "run-id=$RUN_ID"; mkdir -p .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1684/$RUN_ID; gh pr diff 1684 | awk '/^diff --git/{in_logs=/ [ab]\/\.prflow\/logs\//} !in_logs' | tee .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1684/$RUN_ID/diff.patch > /dev/null; echo "exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; wc -l .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1684/$RUN_ID/diff.patch

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1684/run1; gh pr diff 1684 | awk '/^diff --git/{in_logs=/ [ab]\/\.prflow\/logs\//} !in_logs' | tee .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1684/run1/diff.patch > /dev/null; echo "exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; wc -l .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1684/run1/diff.patch

gh issue view 1676 --json comments --jq '.comments[] | select(.body | test("prflow:workpad|devflow:workpad")) | .body' > .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1684/run1/workpad.txt; wc -l .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1684/run1/workpad.txt; echo "=== writing-skills / prompt surface / micro ==="; grep -niE "writing.skills|prompt.surface|micro-test|skill-loaded|guidance-applied|pressure-scenario" .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1684/run1/workpad.txt | head -30

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp
rm -f .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-disabled 2>/dev/null
git status --porcelain -z > .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before && git hash-object .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before
echo "=== overrides ==="
.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/resolve-review-overrides.py "prflow:code-reviewer" "prflow:silent-failure-hunter" "prflow:comment-analyzer" "prflow:requesting-code-review" 2>&1

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
